tools.name: projects_list
tools.description: List your projects with their branches and status. Start here to find project ids. Scope: projects:read.

tools.name: projects_create
tools.description: Create a backend (Postgres, Auth, Storage, Realtime, Functions) and wait until it is live. All arguments are optional. Returns the project URL and publishable key for createClient(). A 402 confirm_billable answer means it adds to the bill: ask the user, then call again with confirm_billable_cents. S

tools.name: keys_get
tools.description: The project URL and publishable (anon) key for supabase-js, as .env lines. The secret (server-only) key is included only with include_secret: true and the keys:secret scope; it bypasses row level security and must never reach client code. Scope: keys:read.

tools.name: projects_start
tools.description: Start a real backend with no account and no bearer token: a temporary project (deleted after about 72h unless claimed). Returns connection details, an agent token to use as the bearer for every other tool, and a claim_url. Show the person the `keep.hint` line at once: only a person can claim the pro

tools.name: sql_execute
tools.description: Run SQL on a branch as the project's database role. Read-only by default; pass read_only: false to write (database:write). DROP, TRUNCATE and DELETE/UPDATE without WHERE need confirm: true and the destructive scope (production:destructive on production). Use migrations_apply for schema changes. Scop

tools.name: migrations_apply
tools.description: Record and apply one migration (name + SQL) in a single transaction, then reload the REST API's schema cache. It is linted first: a table without row level security is blocked. dry_run: true only lints. Destructive SQL needs confirm: true and the destructive scope (production:destructive on producti

tools.name: tables_list
tools.description: Tables on a branch with row counts, and whether row level security is on. Scope: database:read.

tools.name: tables_describe
tools.description: Columns, primary key, foreign keys, indexes, row level security and policies of one table. Scope: database:read.

tools.name: types_generate
tools.description: The supabase-js `Database` TypeScript type for a branch's schema. Save it as database.types.ts and use createClient<Database>(url, key). Scope: database:read.

tools.name: functions_deploy
tools.description: Create or replace an edge function (Deno, TypeScript). Pass `source` for a single file, or `files` (path -> source) with an `entrypoint`. It is served at <project URL>/functions/v1/<name>. Scope: functions:write.

tools.name: storage_buckets_list
tools.description: Storage buckets on a branch. Scope: storage:read.

tools.name: auth_config_get
tools.description: Auth settings (site URL, redirect allow list, JWT expiry, sign-up rules) and providers. Scope: auth:read.

tools.name: logs_get
tools.description: Recent log lines for a branch, newest first: auth, rest, storage, realtime, functions or gateway. Scope: logs:read.

tools.name: branches_list
tools.description: Branches of a project with kind, status, parent and expiry. Production is protected. Scope: branches:read.

tools.name: branches_create
tools.description: Fork a branch from production (or `from`) for one task, agent or pull request: a copy-on-write database with its own URL and keys. Expires after ttl_hours. Returns its URL and publishable key once live. Scope: branches:write.

tools.name: branches_merge
tools.description: Merge a branch's schema changes into its parent (default production). Without apply it is a dry run that shows the plan and conflicts; apply: true with confirm: true applies it. Scope: branches:write.

tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Search Scribase docs: how to connect an app, row level security, branching, migrations, functions, storage, auth, tokens. Returns short answers with links.

tools.name: auth_users
tools.description: List auth users via the per-environment GoTrue admin API. GET .../auth/users.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find Scribase tools that are not listed here, by task or by toolset (database, schema, schedules, services, branches, observability, mobile, platform, org, backups, import). Returns names, descriptions and input schemas; run one with call_tool. No arguments lists the toolsets.

tools.name: call_tool
tools.description: Run any Scribase tool by name, including ones search_tools found that are not listed here. Same scopes, confirmations and limits as calling the tool directly.
